public_case.title: Severe / emergency teaching case: anterior STEMI with proximal LAD occlusion

Diaphoresis, nausea and shortness of breath

simulated_clinical_course.t_plus_0: Persistent pain and STEMI-pattern ECG; emergency pathway choice is time-sensitive.
simulated_clinical_course.t_plus_2: If learner delays escalation, simulated blood pressure falls and alert changes to STOP.
simulated_clinical_course.t_plus_5: If emergency pathway selected, transfer/team activation is logged; do not provide real catheter manipulation instructions.
simulated_clinical_course.post_reperfusion: Successful reference branch: simulated flow improves, symptoms lessen and haemodynamics stabilize with ongoing monitoring. Alternate branch: reperfusion failure or ventricular arrhythmia event triggers team-response simulation and debrief.

learning_objectives: Recognize a STEMI emergency pattern and prioritize escalation.
Understand that biomarker results may lag and should not delay an indicated emergency pathway.
Practice team communication, pre-procedure safety checks, complication recognition and post-reperfusion monitoring.
reference_findings.review_note: Synthetic content requires review and approval by a qualified interventional cardiologist before educational deployment. No values are validated clinical thresholds or instructions.
